evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/marketplace/components/VerificationBadge.tsx:124-126 — isExpiring = expiresAt && (new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now() < 30d) has NO lower bound; an already-EXPIRED badge yields a negative delta which is also < 30d, so an expired verification renders as a still-valid badge with an orange ring and '(Expiring soon)' tooltip instead of expired/invalid — a misleading trust signal on the marketplace

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/marketplace/components/VerificationBadge.tsx:155-158 — same unguarded window in VerificationStatusBadge (status==='verified' && expiryDate && delta < 30d): a verified record whose expiryDate is in the past shows orange 'Expires: <date> (Soon)' rather than an expired state. Fix: require 0 <= delta < 30d (and surface a distinct expired state when delta < 0)
